top_signals.title: Concentration Risk A 'Serious Issue': Rob Arnott
top_signals.summary: Rob Arnott, chairman & founder of Syzygy Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." A renewed wave of dip buying drove stocks toward their best day since April in the wake of a technology selloff that roiled Wall Street, with the market also gaining as oil prices fell. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: A group of private credit lenders is in talks to provide a $1.3 billion loan to finance L Catterton’s acquisition of healthcare platform Fullscript, after the deal was unable to drum up enough interest in the leveraged loan market.
